source_evidence.text:
A.7.1
TRANSFERABILITY TO OTHER KGS
We evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs. We select the MetaQA-3hop dataset (Zhang
et al., 2018) which is based on Wiki-Movies KGs. We select 1000 samples from the training split
and utilize two training strategies to finetune RoG: 1) training from scratch, where we directly train
RoG from LLaMA2-Chat with 1000 samples; 2) transfer from Freebase, where we conduct a further
finetuning based on RoG trained for Freebase. The results are shown in Table 12. From results, we
can see that transfer from Freebase achieves better performance than training from scratch, which
demonstrates the transferability of RoG to other KGs.
We also compare the training time on Freebase and transferring to Wiki-Movies KGs. From results
shown in Table 13, we can see that the training time on Freebase is 38 hours, while the transferring
time is only 2 hours. This demonstrates the efficiency of transferring RoG to other KGs.

source_evidence.text:
Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

source_evidence.text:
EXPERIMENTS
4.1
DATASETS AND METRICS
We evaluated our method on different knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmark datasets, including
two multi-hop KBQA datasets WebQSP (Yih et al., 2016) and QALD10-en (Usbeck et al., 2023), a
multi-hop complex document QA dataset AdvHotpotQA (Ye & Durrett, 2022) which is a challeng-
ing subset of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), a slot filling dataset Zero-Shot RE(Petroni et al., 2021),
and two fact verification dataset FEVER (Thorne et al., 2018) and Creak (Onoe et al., 2021). The
evaluation metric for FEVER and Creak is Accuracy (Acc.), while the metric for other datasets is
Exact Match (EM). Recall and F1 scores are not used since knowledge sources are not limited to
document databases. Following previous work (Li et al., 2024c), full Wikipedia and Wikidata are
used as unstructured and structured knowledge sources for all of these datasets. Compared to the
distractor setting, this full Wiki setting makes the retrieval process more challenging and can better
evaluate the effectiveness of various methods on knowledge reasoning tasks.

cand,n. Consequently, it needs N LLM calls for entity pruning and N
calls for relation pruning, respectively, as well as one additional LLM call for reasoning (evaluating if
the information from the current candidate paths are enough or not). We have to point it out that, for
each of the N starting entities, all its neighbor entities/relations are NOT scored one by one. On the
contrary, all its neighbor entities/relations are "translated" into "one" prompt altogether and are sent to
LLM, which output the top-N candidates at one-time. Therefore, each starting entity only calls LLM
once for pruning and so N starting entities calls LLM N times in one iterative step. Consequently,
there are totally 2ND + D times calling after reasoning D steps. In the end, there is an additional
calling that "translate" the final path to user-understandable language and answer the user. Therefore,
ToG requires 2ND + D + 1 LLM calls in total. Since most questions can be answered within 3 hops
(means depth of reasoning path is 3), and the performance is usually good enough when the search
width N=3 as we tested in Figure 3, the total number of LLM calling is 2 × 3 × 3 + 3 + 1 = 22. So
the computational time is about 21 times longer than that of LLM-only. With a similar performance
to ToG, its variant ToG-R only calls LLM for ND + D + 1 times by using random entity pruning
instead of LLM-based entity pruning, saving nearly half of computational time.

source_evidence.text:
building a search tree over the resulting reasoning
chains. We extend this approach to augment LLMs
with KGs through allowing the generation of ac-
tions in addition to thoughts, and building a search
tree over them. Challenges arise because Tree-of-
Thoughts was not designed to incorporate actions
and was not designed for knowledge intensive ques-
tion answering tasks. As a result, we introduce
some modifications: incorporation of actions via
the ASM, a slightly different search procedure and
stopping condition to better handle QA, and a dif-
ferent sampling procedure for improved diversity
when doing constrained sampling.
Algorithm 1 presents the Tree-of-Traversals tree
search algorithm. Given a query q it begins with
initialization using initialize(q) as described
in Section 2.1. After initialization, it searches by
(1) choosing the unexplored node to expand based
on the node’s value assigned by the value func-
tion (Best First→Depth First as tie-breaker), (2)
sampling k actions from the LLM (k is branching
factor) using the prompt associated with the se-
lected node’s state in the ASM, (3) for each of the
sampled action, applying the transition function,
and (4) evaluating the value of the resulting nodes
with the LLM value function. The search stops
when an answer is found with a node value exceed-
ing the threshold τ. To bound the search space
we add two hyper-parameters: max depth of the
tree search, after which the algorithm is forced to
transition to the done state (i.e., answer the query),
and max expansions after which the model halts
exploration and returns "Cannot find answer".

scoring_rules.primary: All required source papers retained; measured using inherited references only after assembly.
secondary: MRR@40: reciprocal first rank containing any known supporting unit
scoring_rules.denominator: 16 failure-selected cross-text cases; before/after paired evidence replay. Not comparable to full v2 averages.
scoring_rules.relevance: 仅原文核查后的有限支持池；没有穷举所有等价来源，池外不等于不相关。
scoring_rules.latency: Evidence assembly only, excluding retrieval, reranking and generation. Historical timings are separate.
scoring_rules.p95: 按各类别及全部可回答题分别计算，单次小样本不表示 SLA。
scoring_rules.answer_review: No new answers generated. No answer accuracy or citation success change is claimed.
scoring_rules.relation_gold: reasoning_chain 为人工可审阅的分析提纲，不是生产图路径金标；共享基准、分析比较不自动对应图谱 Schema 边。
scoring_rules.interpretation: 分别报告基础、跨文本、反例表现；新旧题集分布不同，不能由总分变化推导系统改善或 Graph 胜出。

evaluation_config.planned_output: 固定旧候选的证据选择回放；不生成新回答。

controls.query_vectors: one batched cloud call, reused unchanged across paired arms
controls.order: odd numbered case Hybrid first, even Graph first; one warmup; no response retries
controls.generation_policy: 基础 8 题仅检索；24 道关系题与 8 道反例按证据门控生成，最多 64 次配对生成调用。

comparison.changed: question-driven source recognition and evidence reservation
comparison.generation: No generation replayed; parent answers remain historical context only.

A.7.1
TRANSFERABILITY TO OTHER KGS
We evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs. We select the MetaQA-3hop dataset (Zhang
et al., 2018) which is based on Wiki-Movies KGs. We select 1000 samples from the training split
and utilize two training strategies to finetune RoG: 1) training from scratch, where we directly train
RoG from LLaMA2-Chat with 1000 samples; 2) transfer from Freebase, where we conduct a further
finetuning based on RoG trained for Freebase. The results are shown in Table 12. From results, we
can see that transfer from Freebase achieves better performance than training from scratch, which
demonstrates the transferability of RoG to other KGs.
We also compare the training time on Freebase and transferring to Wiki-Movies KGs. From results
shown in Table 13, we can see that the training time on Freebase is 38 hours, while the transferring
time is only 2 hours. This demonstrates the efficiency of transferring RoG to other KGs.

chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011.title: Learning to Plan for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models from Knowledge Graphs
chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011.source_relative_path: Methods/024_Learning to Plan for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models from Knowledge Graphs.pdf
chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011.text:
Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

chunk_16f86a00cebdf5e10d83c3a540fbc7f7.title: Think-on-Graph 2.0: Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Graph-guided Retrieval
chunk_16f86a00cebdf5e10d83c3a540fbc7f7.source_relative_path: Methods/015_Think-on-Graph 2.0 Deep and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning with Knowledge Gr.pdf
chunk_16f86a00cebdf5e10d83c3a540fbc7f7.text:
EXPERIMENTS
4.1
DATASETS AND METRICS
We evaluated our method on different knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmark datasets, including
two multi-hop KBQA datasets WebQSP (Yih et al., 2016) and QALD10-en (Usbeck et al., 2023), a
multi-hop complex document QA dataset AdvHotpotQA (Ye & Durrett, 2022) which is a challeng-
ing subset of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), a slot filling dataset Zero-Shot RE(Petroni et al., 2021),
and two fact verification dataset FEVER (Thorne et al., 2018) and Creak (Onoe et al., 2021). The
evaluation metric for FEVER and Creak is Accuracy (Acc.), while the metric for other datasets is
Exact Match (EM). Recall and F1 scores are not used since knowledge sources are not limited to
document databases. Following previous work (Li et al., 2024c), full Wikipedia and Wikidata are
used as unstructured and structured knowledge sources for all of these datasets. Compared to the
distractor setting, this full Wiki setting makes the retrieval process more challenging and can better
evaluate the effectiveness of various methods on knowledge reasoning tasks.

Table 1 presents the results of our experiments on

that much of this gain is due to Tree-of-Traversals’

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
Do different KGs affect ToG’s performance?
One of the main advantages of ToG is its plug-and-
play capabilities. As shown in Table 3, ToG achieves significant improvements with different source
KGs on CWQ and WebQSP, compared to CoT. On the other hand, different source KGs might have

2ND + D + 1 is the maximal computational complexity. In most cases, ToG does not need
2ND + D + 1 LLM calls for a question because the whole reasoning process might be early stopped
before the maximum reasoning depth D is reached if LLM determines enough information has been
retrieved. Likewise, ToG-R does not really need ND + D + 1 LLM calls in most cases. As an
illustration, Table 7 and Table 8 show the average numbers of LLM calls per question needed by ToG
on different datasets. It can be seen that in the four multi-hop KBQA datasets, the average numbers
of LLM calls (ranging from 10 to 15) are significantly smaller than 22, which is the theoretical
maximum number of LLM calls calculated from 2ND + D + 1 when N=3 and D=3. We can also
see that this AVERAGE number gets even smaller (< 10) for single-hop reasoning datasets, such as
SimpleQuestion and T-REx.

state-of-the-art performance on the KGQA tasks? RQ2: Can the planning module of RoG be inte-
grated with other LLMs to improve their performance? RQ3: Can RoG conduct faithful reasoning

graph for both datasets, which contains around 88 million entities, 20 thousand relations, and 126
million triples. The details of the datasets are described in Appendix A.4.

items.reference_excerpt:
A.7.1
TRANSFERABILITY TO OTHER KGS
We evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs. We select the MetaQA-3hop dataset (Zhang
et al., 2018) which is based on Wiki-Movies KGs. We select 1000 samples from the training split
and utilize two training strategies to finetune RoG: 1) training from scratch, where we directly train
RoG from LLaMA2-Chat with 1000 samples; 2) transfer from Freebase, where we conduct a further
finetuning based on RoG trained for Freebase. The results are shown in Table 12. From results, we
can see that transfer from Freebase achieves better performance than training from scratch, which
demonstrates the transferability of RoG to other KGs.
We also compare the training time on Freebase and transferring to Wiki-Movies KGs. From results
shown in Table 13, we can see that the training time on Freebase is 38 hours, while the transferring
time is only 2 hours. This demonstrates the efficiency of transferring RoG to other KGs.

EXPERIMENT
In our experiments, we aim to answer the following research questions: RQ1: Can RoG achieve
state-of-the-art performance on the KGQA tasks? RQ2: Can the planning module of RoG be inte-
grated with other LLMs to improve their performance? RQ3: Can RoG conduct faithful reasoning
and generate interpretable reasoning results?
5.1
EXPERIMENT SETTINGS
Datasets. We evaluate the reasoning ability of RoG on two benchmark KGQA datasets: WebQues-
tionSP (WebQSP) (Yih et al., 2016) and Complex WebQuestions (CWQ) (Talmor & Berant, 2018),
which contain up to 4-hop questions. Freebase (Bollacker et al., 2008) is the background knowledge
graph for both datasets, which contains around 88 million entities, 20 thousand relations, and 126
million triples. The details of the datasets are described in Appendix A.4.
3The relation name r∗could be split into multiple tokens. For example, “born in” could be split into
“born” and “ in” by tokenizer. In this way, we could fully utilize the semantic information in relation names
and generalize to different KGs.

items.reference_excerpt:
A.7.1
TRANSFERABILITY TO OTHER KGS
We evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs. We select the MetaQA-3hop dataset (Zhang
et al., 2018) which is based on Wiki-Movies KGs. We select 1000 samples from the training split
and utilize two training strategies to finetune RoG: 1) training from scratch, where we directly train
RoG from LLaMA2-Chat with 1000 samples; 2) transfer from Freebase, where we conduct a further
finetuning based on RoG trained for Freebase. The results are shown in Table 12. From results, we
can see that transfer from Freebase achieves better performance than training from scratch, which
demonstrates the transferability of RoG to other KGs.
We also compare the training time on Freebase and transferring to Wiki-Movies KGs. From results
shown in Table 13, we can see that the training time on Freebase is 38 hours, while the transferring
time is only 2 hours. This demonstrates the efficiency of transferring RoG to other KGs.

items.reference_excerpt:
A.7.1
TRANSFERABILITY TO OTHER KGS
We evaluate the transferability of RoG to other KGs. We select the MetaQA-3hop dataset (Zhang
et al., 2018) which is based on Wiki-Movies KGs. We select 1000 samples from the training split
and utilize two training strategies to finetune RoG: 1) training from scratch, where we directly train
RoG from LLaMA2-Chat with 1000 samples; 2) transfer from Freebase, where we conduct a further
finetuning based on RoG trained for Freebase. The results are shown in Table 12. From results, we
can see that transfer from Freebase achieves better performance than training from scratch, which
demonstrates the transferability of RoG to other KGs.
We also compare the training time on Freebase and transferring to Wiki-Movies KGs. From results
shown in Table 13, we can see that the training time on Freebase is 38 hours, while the transferring
time is only 2 hours. This demonstrates the efficiency of transferring RoG to other KGs.

reviews.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 是为此前不存在的“综合多个 KG 信息回答单个问题”场景新建的数据集，包含109个需要同时用 MusicBrainz 与 Wikidata 信息推理的问题，由人工标注者按“在这两个KG之间找推理路径”的指示构造 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；该工作还主张其算法可用任意数量的KG增强LLM [chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 则从 Wikidata 的一个子集构建，以“如上所述的丰富模式”接地 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。能力考察上，CLQA-Wiki 均匀覆盖 multi-hop、comparison、intersection、union 四类问题，并被作者描述为现有复杂QA基准多聚焦多跳和比较、缺少逻辑操作 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]；MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 的证据只说明问题需要同时使用两个KG的信息进行推理，未给出与CLQA-Wiki对应的题型分类描述 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]。因此二者虽都涉及Wikidata，但原文对CLQA-Wiki有明确的四类题型覆盖面陈述，对MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata缺少同口径的题型分解，不能据此断言两者在具体关系推理类型上逐一对应或互有优劣；两数据集也未提供可比较的统一实验条件。

evidence.title: Learning to Plan for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models from Knowledge Graphs
evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/024_Learning to Plan for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models from Knowledge Graphs.pdf
evidence.quote:
Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

use-case of Tree-of-Traversals is synthesizing and

questions. The curated questions were checked for

ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho

primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type

ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive

enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-

sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA

better results than popular baselines on multiple

reviews.answer: Tree-of-Traversals 的 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 是作者新建的数据集，要求同时使用 MusicBrainz 和 Wikidata 两个知识图谱的信息进行推理，用于测试多知识图谱推理能力 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；该数据集被用于评测 Tree-of-Traversals [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998]。LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki 是从 Wikidata 的一个子集构建的综合逻辑问答基准，覆盖多跳、比较、交集和并集类型问题 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。区别在于：MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 侧重跨两个知识图谱来源综合信息进行推理 [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；CLQA-Wiki 侧重在 Wikidata 上考察多跳、比较、交集和并集等逻辑操作型复杂问答 [chunk_ab66789d9bc91de68948962d6c3f0011]。原文未给出两者在相同模型或协议下的可比结果，因此不能据此判断优劣。

items.answer_excerpt: 从 Wikidata 的一个子集构建
items.reference_excerpt:
Additionally, we construct a Comprehensive
Logical QA benchmark, CLQA-Wiki, from a sub-
set of Wikidata (Vrandecic and Krötzsch, 2014) via
grounding rich patterns as aforementioned. Exist-
ing complex QA benchmarks (Yang et al., 2018; Ho
et al., 2020; Press et al., 2023; Trivedi et al., 2022)
primarily focus on multi-hop and comparison-type
questions and lack logical operations. Furthermore,
most questions are labeled with only one answer,
whereas in reality, they often have multiple correct
answers. The CLQA-Wiki benchmark evenly cov-
ers multi-hop, comparison, intersection, and union
types of questions, which is more comprehensive
and challenging for complex QA evaluation.
Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
(1) We introduce a novel framework LPKG that
enhances the planning ability of LLMs using data
constructed from KG patterns; (2) We develop a
comprehensive and challenging evaluation bench-
mark, named CLQA-Wiki, to more effectively as-
sess the performance of LLMs on complex QA
tasks; (3) Our proposed framework LPKG achieves
better results than popular baselines on multiple
conventional complex QA benchmarks, and we
verify the effectiveness of the introduction of KG-
sourced planning data.

items.label: AdvHotpotQA 是 HotpotQA 的挑战子集
items.reference_excerpt:
EXPERIMENTS
4.1
DATASETS AND METRICS
We evaluated our method on different knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmark datasets, including
two multi-hop KBQA datasets WebQSP (Yih et al., 2016) and QALD10-en (Usbeck et al., 2023), a
multi-hop complex document QA dataset AdvHotpotQA (Ye & Durrett, 2022) which is a challeng-
ing subset of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), a slot filling dataset Zero-Shot RE(Petroni et al., 2021),
and two fact verification dataset FEVER (Thorne et al., 2018) and Creak (Onoe et al., 2021). The
evaluation metric for FEVER and Creak is Accuracy (Acc.), while the metric for other datasets is
Exact Match (EM). Recall and F1 scores are not used since knowledge sources are not limited to
document databases. Following previous work (Li et al., 2024c), full Wikipedia and Wikidata are
used as unstructured and structured knowledge sources for all of these datasets. Compared to the
distractor setting, this full Wiki setting makes the retrieval process more challenging and can better
evaluate the effectiveness of various methods on knowledge reasoning tasks.

items.label: HippoRAG 每个验证集取 1000 题并汇集支持/干扰段落
items.reference_excerpt:
We evaluate our method’s retrieval capabilities primarily on two challenging multi-hop QA bench-
marks, MuSiQue (answerable) [77] and 2WikiMultiHopQA [33]. For completeness, we also
include the HotpotQA [89] dataset even though it has been found to be a much weaker test for
multi-hop reasoning due to many spurious signals [77], as we also show in Appendix B. To limit
the experimental cost, we extract 1,000 questions from each validation set as done in previous work
[63, 78]. In order to create a more realistic retrieval setting, we follow IRCoT [78] and collect all

reviews.answer: 两条证据支持的共同点仅是数据集名称：HippoRAG 在含 HotpotQA 的数据集上评测，ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上评测，二者并非同一数据集，关系不明确。[chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765] HippoRAG 使用 recall@2/recall@5 报告检索性能，并用 exact match 和 F1 报告 QA 性能；比较对象包括 BM25、Contriever、GTR、ColBERTv2 等检索方法和 IRCoT。[chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765][chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674] ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 等数据集上使用 GPT-3.5-turbo，其表格以 EM 为单位。[chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df] 这些说明显示：数据集不同（HotpotQA 与 AdvHotpotQA），检索指标与表格单位不同，底座模型设置不一致。因此，不能仅凭这些设置说明直接把 HippoRAG 的 HotpotQA 结果与 ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 检索结果数字作比较；流程证据不足以判断可比性。[chunk_d374bd95d509d622be8512f20e59b674][chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]

The main results of several open-source datasets are shown in Table 1. We note that ToG-2 out-
performs other baselines on WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, and Zero-Shot RE. Notably,
WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA and QALD-10-en are multi-hop reasoning datasets. On Fever, ToG-2 has
a competitive performance to CoK since the fact statements in Fever mainly are about single-hop
relations and thus do not need in-depth information retrieval. In another fact verification dataset
Creak, all fact statements can be verified based on Wikidata. Thus, ToG-2 and ToG have similar per-
formances on Creak. Meanwhile, compared to original ToG, ToG-2 achieved a substantial improve-

(4.93% on WebQSP, 3.85% on QALD-10-en, 3% on Zero-Shot RE, and 10.4% on FEVER). This

reviews.answer: HippoRAG 在 HotpotQA 上报告了检索与 QA 结果 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]，其中提到 HippoRAG 在“less challenging HotpotQA dataset”上与基线表现相当 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]；其同段还说明 QA 使用 EM 与 F1 指标 [chunk_8cc831cc45851cce50b9f34648070765]。ToG-2 的 AdvHotpotQA 是其评测数据集之一，表 1 标注该列为 EM [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]，且 ToG-2 在 AdvHotpotQA 上为 42.9% [chunk_2e13f6f43858420cb85904c33d3b39df]。但现有证据未说明 AdvHotpotQA 与 HotpotQA 的构造、数据划分或题目对应关系，也未给出两种方法在相同底座模型、相同检索/QA协议下的统一评测设置；因此不能仅凭结果数字直接比较两种检索方法。

performs other baselines on WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA, QALD-10-en, and Zero-Shot RE. Notably,
WebQSP, AdvHotpotQA and QALD-10-en are multi-hop reasoning datasets. On Fever, ToG-2 has
a competitive performance to CoK since the fact statements in Fever mainly are about single-hop
relations and thus do not need in-depth information retrieval. In another fact verification dataset
Creak, all fact statements can be verified based on Wikidata. Thus, ToG-2 and ToG have similar per-
formances on Creak. Meanwhile, compared to original ToG, ToG-2 achieved a substantial improve-

(4.93% on WebQSP, 3.85% on QALD-10-en, 3% on Zero-Shot RE, and 10.4% on FEVER). This

We evaluate our method’s retrieval capabilities primarily on two challenging multi-hop QA bench-
marks, MuSiQue (answerable) [77] and 2WikiMultiHopQA [33]. For completeness, we also
include the HotpotQA [89] dataset even though it has been found to be a much weaker test for
multi-hop reasoning due to many spurious signals [77], as we also show in Appendix B. To limit
the experimental cost, we extract 1,000 questions from each validation set as done in previous work
[63, 78]. In order to create a more realistic retrieval setting, we follow IRCoT [78] and collect all
candidate passages (including supporting and distractor passages) from our selected questions and
form a retrieval corpus for each dataset. The details of these datasets are shown in Table 1.

items.label: ToG-2 使用 full Wikipedia/Wikidata
items.reference_excerpt:
EXPERIMENTS
4.1
DATASETS AND METRICS
We evaluated our method on different knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmark datasets, including
two multi-hop KBQA datasets WebQSP (Yih et al., 2016) and QALD10-en (Usbeck et al., 2023), a
multi-hop complex document QA dataset AdvHotpotQA (Ye & Durrett, 2022) which is a challeng-
ing subset of HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), a slot filling dataset Zero-Shot RE(Petroni et al., 2021),
and two fact verification dataset FEVER (Thorne et al., 2018) and Creak (Onoe et al., 2021). The
evaluation metric for FEVER and Creak is Accuracy (Acc.), while the metric for other datasets is
Exact Match (EM). Recall and F1 scores are not used since knowledge sources are not limited to
document databases. Following previous work (Li et al., 2024c), full Wikipedia and Wikidata are
used as unstructured and structured knowledge sources for all of these datasets. Compared to the
distractor setting, this full Wiki setting makes the retrieval process more challenging and can better
evaluate the effectiveness of various methods on knowledge reasoning tasks.

reviews.answer: ToG 的搜索深度与宽度会提高性能，但计算代价随深度线性增加，因此默认将深度和宽度都设为3；当深度超过3后，性能增长会减弱 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。ToG 的理论最大 LLM 调用次数为 2ND + D + 1，其中 N 是宽度、D 是深度；但原文指出，由于可能在达到最大深度前提前停止，多数情况下不会达到该上限 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。ToG-R 最多需要 ND + D + 1 次 LLM 调用，并使用随机束搜索（random beam search）代替 LLM 约束的束搜索 [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。关于 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度和扩展预算如何与 LLM 调用次数对应，现有证据只有结论段，未描述这些参数或调用次数公式，因此这方面的流程证据不足，无法直接对照其深度、扩展预算与 ToG/ToG-R 的公式或上限 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]。同样，所给证据没有 Tree-of-Traversals 的实验设置、指标或运行时数据，无法据此换算成统一的运行时排名；不能把 ToG 的公式上限和默认深度/宽度当作跨算法的可比运行时指标 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]。

evidence.quote:
Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
Do different KGs affect ToG’s performance?
One of the main advantages of ToG is its plug-and-
play capabilities. As shown in Table 3, ToG achieves significant improvements with different source
KGs on CWQ and WebQSP, compared to CoT. On the other hand, different source KGs might have

Tree-of-Traversals is a powerful algorithm that en-
ables LLMs to utilize KG reasoning with zero
examples, no schema dependency, and no train-
ing. We demonstrate its efficacy experimentally
on multiple LLMs and datasets. We hope Tree-of-
Traversals continues to be developed and see value
in studying integration with personalized user KGs
as well as with other domain-specific datasets.

Compared to ToG, ToG-R offers two key benefits: 1) It eliminates the need for the process of pruning

literal information of intermediate entities is missing or unfamiliar to the LLM.

items.label: ToG 调用上界 2ND+D+1，并联系搜索宽度/深度
items.answer_excerpt: 2ND + D + 1，其中 N 是宽度、D 是深度
items.reference_excerpt:
cand,n. Consequently, it needs N LLM calls for entity pruning and N
calls for relation pruning, respectively, as well as one additional LLM call for reasoning (evaluating if
the information from the current candidate paths are enough or not). We have to point it out that, for
each of the N starting entities, all its neighbor entities/relations are NOT scored one by one. On the
contrary, all its neighbor entities/relations are "translated" into "one" prompt altogether and are sent to
LLM, which output the top-N candidates at one-time. Therefore, each starting entity only calls LLM
once for pruning and so N starting entities calls LLM N times in one iterative step. Consequently,
there are totally 2ND + D times calling after reasoning D steps. In the end, there is an additional
calling that "translate" the final path to user-understandable language and answer the user. Therefore,
ToG requires 2ND + D + 1 LLM calls in total. Since most questions can be answered within 3 hops
(means depth of reasoning path is 3), and the performance is usually good enough when the search
width N=3 as we tested in Figure 3, the total number of LLM calling is 2 × 3 × 3 + 3 + 1 = 22. So
the computational time is about 21 times longer than that of LLM-only. With a similar performance
to ToG, its variant ToG-R only calls LLM for ND + D + 1 times by using random entity pruning
instead of LLM-based entity pruning, saving nearly half of computational time.

items.label: Tree-of-Traversals max depth 强制进入 done
items.reference_excerpt:
building a search tree over the resulting reasoning
chains. We extend this approach to augment LLMs
with KGs through allowing the generation of ac-
tions in addition to thoughts, and building a search
tree over them. Challenges arise because Tree-of-
Thoughts was not designed to incorporate actions
and was not designed for knowledge intensive ques-
tion answering tasks. As a result, we introduce
some modifications: incorporation of actions via
the ASM, a slightly different search procedure and
stopping condition to better handle QA, and a dif-
ferent sampling procedure for improved diversity
when doing constrained sampling.
Algorithm 1 presents the Tree-of-Traversals tree
search algorithm. Given a query q it begins with
initialization using initialize(q) as described
in Section 2.1. After initialization, it searches by
(1) choosing the unexplored node to expand based
on the node’s value assigned by the value func-
tion (Best First→Depth First as tie-breaker), (2)
sampling k actions from the LLM (k is branching
factor) using the prompt associated with the se-
lected node’s state in the ASM, (3) for each of the
sampled action, applying the transition function,
and (4) evaluating the value of the resulting nodes
with the LLM value function. The search stops
when an answer is found with a node value exceed-
ing the threshold τ. To bound the search space
we add two hyper-parameters: max depth of the
tree search, after which the algorithm is forced to
transition to the done state (i.e., answer the query),
and max expansions after which the model halts
exploration and returns "Cannot find answer".

chains. We extend this approach to augment LLMs
with KGs through allowing the generation of ac-

and was not designed for knowledge intensive ques-
tion answering tasks. As a result, we introduce
some modifications: incorporation of actions via
the ASM, a slightly different search procedure and
stopping condition to better handle QA, and a dif-
ferent sampling procedure for improved diversity
when doing constrained sampling.
Algorithm 1 presents the Tree-of-Traversals tree
search algorithm. Given a query q it begins with
initialization using initialize(q) as described
in Section 2.1. After initialization, it searches by
(1) choosing the unexplored node to expand based
on the node’s value assigned by the value func-
tion (Best First→Depth First as tie-breaker), (2)
sampling k actions from the LLM (k is branching
factor) using the prompt associated with the se-
lected node’s state in the ASM, (3) for each of the
sampled action, applying the transition function,
and (4) evaluating the value of the resulting nodes
with the LLM value function. The search stops
when an answer is found with a node value exceed-
ing the threshold τ. To bound the search space
we add two hyper-parameters: max depth of the
tree search, after which the algorithm is forced to
transition to the done state (i.e., answer the query),
and max expansions after which the model halts
exploration and returns "Cannot find answer".

reviews.answer: ToG 的搜索深度与宽度对性能及成本的影响在原文中有直接讨论：性能随搜索深度和宽度提升，但由于计算成本随深度线性增加，作者将深度和宽度默认都设为 3；当深度超过 3 后性能增长减弱 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。ToG 的最大LLM调用次数由复杂度式给出：2ND+D+1 是最大计算复杂度，且在多数情况下会提前停止、并不需要达到该上限；当 N=3、D=3 时理论最大为 22 次，而四个多跳KBQA数据集的平均调用为 10 到 15 次 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。ToG-R 则“needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM”，同样多数情况下不需要这么多 [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4][chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。对于 Tree-of-Traversals，所给证据只有结论段，称其为零样本、无模式依赖、无需训练的算法 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]；其中没有深度或扩展预算的具体定义、上界公式，也没有其LLM调用次数如何与深度/预算关联的方法描述，因此无法将ToG/ToG-R的调用上界与Tree-of-Traversals的深度、扩展预算作数值换算。也不能据此得到统一运行时排名：ToG/ToG-R的公式含随实际早停变化的“最大/至多”语义，原文明确指出多数情况低于上限 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]，而Tree-of-Traversals的对应预算与调用关系证据不足 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]。这些公式/上限描述的是调用次数的理论边界而非可比运行时，加上Tree-of-Traversals缺项，无法统一换算为运行时排名。

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
Do different KGs affect ToG’s performance?
One of the main advantages of ToG is its plug-and-
play capabilities. As shown in Table 3, ToG achieves significant improvements with different source
KGs on CWQ and WebQSP, compared to CoT. On the other hand, different source KGs might have

each of the N starting entities, all its neighbor entities/relations are NOT scored one by one. On the
contrary, all its neighbor entities/relations are "translated" into "one" prompt altogether and are sent to
LLM, which output the top-N candidates at one-time. Therefore, each starting entity only calls LLM

(means depth of reasoning path is 3), and the performance is usually good enough when the search
width N=3 as we tested in Figure 3, the total number of LLM calling is 2 × 3 × 3 + 3 + 1 = 22. So
the computational time is about 21 times longer than that of LLM-only. With a similar performance
to ToG, its variant ToG-R only calls LLM for ND + D + 1 times by using random entity pruning
instead of LLM-based entity pruning, saving nearly half of computational time.

items.reference_excerpt:
building a search tree over the resulting reasoning
chains. We extend this approach to augment LLMs
with KGs through allowing the generation of ac-
tions in addition to thoughts, and building a search
tree over them. Challenges arise because Tree-of-
Thoughts was not designed to incorporate actions
and was not designed for knowledge intensive ques-
tion answering tasks. As a result, we introduce
some modifications: incorporation of actions via
the ASM, a slightly different search procedure and
stopping condition to better handle QA, and a dif-
ferent sampling procedure for improved diversity
when doing constrained sampling.
Algorithm 1 presents the Tree-of-Traversals tree
search algorithm. Given a query q it begins with
initialization using initialize(q) as described
in Section 2.1. After initialization, it searches by
(1) choosing the unexplored node to expand based
on the node’s value assigned by the value func-
tion (Best First→Depth First as tie-breaker), (2)
sampling k actions from the LLM (k is branching
factor) using the prompt associated with the se-
lected node’s state in the ASM, (3) for each of the
sampled action, applying the transition function,
and (4) evaluating the value of the resulting nodes
with the LLM value function. The search stops
when an answer is found with a node value exceed-
ing the threshold τ. To bound the search space
we add two hyper-parameters: max depth of the
tree search, after which the algorithm is forced to
transition to the done state (i.e., answer the query),
and max expansions after which the model halts
exploration and returns "Cannot find answer".

reviews.answer: ToG 的搜索深度 D 与宽度 N 影响性能：原文称 ToG 性能随搜索深度和宽度提升，但计算成本随深度线性增长，因此默认把深度和宽度都设为 3 [chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644]。ToG 的 LLM 调用次数上限：原文给出 2ND+D+1 是最大计算复杂度，并举例 N=3、D=3 时理论最大为 22 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。ToG-R 的调用次数上限：原文明确称 ToG-R 最多需要 ND+D+1 次 LLM 调用 [chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4]。两项上限都只是上界：ToG 在多数情况下不会达到 2ND+D+1 次调用，可能提前停止；ToG-R 在多数情况下也不需要 ND+D+1 次调用 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]。关于 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度与扩展预算及对应公式：提供的证据中只有结论性概述，称其是零样本、不依赖 schema、无需训练的 KG 推理算法 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]，没有给出深度或扩展预算的公式或上限，因此这部分流程证据不足。上述 ToG/ToG-R 上限是 LLM 调用次数上界，其可达性还受提前停止影响 [chunk_f99077c01e2b49914150ff933b0cf783]；同时缺少 Tree-of-Traversals 的预算定义与调用次数证据 [chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]，不能把这些公式/上限直接换算成统一的运行时排名。

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
Do different KGs affect ToG’s performance?
One of the main advantages of ToG is its plug-and-
play capabilities. As shown in Table 3, ToG achieves significant improvements with different source
KGs on CWQ and WebQSP, compared to CoT. On the other hand, different source KGs might have

Tree-of-Traversals is a powerful algorithm that en-
ables LLMs to utilize KG reasoning with zero
examples, no schema dependency, and no train-
ing. We demonstrate its efficacy experimentally
on multiple LLMs and datasets. We hope Tree-of-
Traversals continues to be developed and see value
in studying integration with personalized user KGs
as well as with other domain-specific datasets.

literal information of intermediate entities is missing or unfamiliar to the LLM.

items.label: ToG 调用上界 2ND+D+1，并联系搜索宽度/深度
items.answer_excerpt: 2ND+D+1 是最大计算复杂度
items.reference_excerpt:
cand,n. Consequently, it needs N LLM calls for entity pruning and N
calls for relation pruning, respectively, as well as one additional LLM call for reasoning (evaluating if
the information from the current candidate paths are enough or not). We have to point it out that, for
each of the N starting entities, all its neighbor entities/relations are NOT scored one by one. On the
contrary, all its neighbor entities/relations are "translated" into "one" prompt altogether and are sent to
LLM, which output the top-N candidates at one-time. Therefore, each starting entity only calls LLM
once for pruning and so N starting entities calls LLM N times in one iterative step. Consequently,
there are totally 2ND + D times calling after reasoning D steps. In the end, there is an additional
calling that "translate" the final path to user-understandable language and answer the user. Therefore,
ToG requires 2ND + D + 1 LLM calls in total. Since most questions can be answered within 3 hops
(means depth of reasoning path is 3), and the performance is usually good enough when the search
width N=3 as we tested in Figure 3, the total number of LLM calling is 2 × 3 × 3 + 3 + 1 = 22. So
the computational time is about 21 times longer than that of LLM-only. With a similar performance
to ToG, its variant ToG-R only calls LLM for ND + D + 1 times by using random entity pruning
instead of LLM-based entity pruning, saving nearly half of computational time.
